help_text: ℹ️ How does this bot work? 1. The bot monitors cheapestinference.com/pools 24/7 through an anonymous Tor/proxy connection. 2. Each subscription tier is split into three daily 8-hour blocks (Asia, Europe, Americas). 3. View real-time availability using the menu buttons. 4. Under 🔔 My Alerts, configure granular notifications for specific tiers or regional time blocks. 5. The moment a slot opens, you receive an instant alert with a direct checkout link! 👨‍💻 Developer & Support Contact: Telegram: @grizlizora
